figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC

parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.sql: FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id
parts.note: 数据来自 表 traffic_sources、中间结果 a、中间结果 b，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.note: 按 contribution_cents DESC 排列结果。
